title: Wonderful, which helps enterprises deploy AI, raised a $550M Series C led by Insight at a $5B valuation; investors also paid $170M for shares from employees (Yuliya Chernova/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Yuliya Chernova / Wall Street Journal: Wonderful, which helps enterprises deploy AI, raised a $550M Series C led by Insight at a $5B valuation; investors also paid $170M for shares from employees — Founded just last year, the startup already has 650 employees and is expanding its forward-deployed engineering teams around the world
